items.source: The name attribute of each hint refers to the name of a property. In the initial example shown earlier, we provide five values for the spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto property: none, validate, update, create, and create-drop. Each value may have a description as well.
items.translation: 每个提示的 name` 属性对应一个属性的 `name`。在之前显示的初始示例中，我们为 `spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto 属性提供了五个值：none、validate、update、create和create-drop。每个值可能还包含描述信息。

items.source: If your property is of type Map, you can provide hints for both the keys and the values (but not for the map itself). The special .keys and .values suffixes must refer to the keys and the values, respectively.
items.translation: 如果您的属性类型为Map，您可以为键和值提供提示（但不能为 Map 本身提供提示）。特殊后缀.keys和.values必须分别指代键和值。

items.source: Any Enum: Lists the possible values for the property. (We recommend defining the property with the Enum type, as no further hint should be required for the IDE to auto-complete the values)
items.translation: 任何 `Enum`：列出该属性的可能值。（我们建议使用 `Enum` 类型定义该属性，因为这样无需 IDE 进一步提示即可自动完成这些值的输入）

items.source: The handle-as provider lets you substitute the type of the property to a more high-level type. This typically happens when the property has a String type, because you do not want your configuration classes to rely on classes that may not be on the classpath. This provider supports the following parameters:
items.translation: handle-as 提供者允许将属性的类型替换为更高级别的类型。这通常发生在属性具有 String 类型的情况下，因为您不希望配置类依赖于可能不在类路径中的类。该提供者支持以下参数：

items.source: Charset: Supports auto-completion of charset/encoding values (such as UTF-8)
items.translation: Charset：支持 charset/encoding 值的自动补全（例如 UTF-8）

items.source: Locale: auto-completion of locales (such as en_US)
items.translation: Locale：本地化名称的自动补全（例如 en_US）

items.source: MimeType: Supports auto-completion of content type values (such as text/plain)
items.translation: MimeType：支持内容类型值（如 text/plain）的自动补全。

items.source: Resource: Supports auto-completion of Spring’s Resource abstraction to refer to a file on the filesystem or on the classpath (such as classpath:/sample.properties)
items.translation: Resource：支持自动完成 Spring 的 Resource 抽象，以引用文件系统中的文件或类路径上的文件（例如 classpath:/sample.properties）。

It is actually used internally as a Resource but cannot be exposed as such, because we need to keep the original String value to pass it to the Liquibase API.

items.source: The logger-name provider auto-completes valid logger names and logger groups. Typically, package and class names available in the current project can be auto-completed. If groups are enabled (default) and if a custom logger group is identified in the configuration, auto-completion for it should be provided. Specific frameworks may have extra magic logger names that can be supported as well.
items.translation: logger-name 提供者会自动补全有效的记录器名称和记录器组。通常，当前项目中可用的包名和类名可以自动补全。如果启用了组（默认）且在配置中识别出自定义记录器组，则应为其提供自动补全功能。特定框架可能还具有额外的魔法记录器名称，也可以予以支持。

items.source: The following metadata snippet corresponds to the standard logging.level property. Keys are logger names, and values correspond to the standard log levels or any custom level. As Spring Boot defines a few logger groups out-of-the-box, dedicated value hints have been added for those.
items.translation: 以下元数据片段对应于标准 logging.level 属性。键为记录器名称，值对应于标准日志级别或任何自定义级别。由于 Spring Boot 内置定义了一些记录器组，因此已为这些组添加了专用的值提示。

items.source: Auto-completes the classes available in the project. Usually constrained by a base class that is specified by the target parameter.
items.translation: 自动完成项目中可用的类。通常受由 `target` 参数指定的基类约束。

items.source: Handles the property as if it were defined by the type defined by the mandatory target parameter.
items.translation: 将属性视为由必需参数 target 指定的类型所定义。

items.source: Auto-completes valid logger names and logger groups. Typically, package and class names available in the current project can be auto-completed as well as defined groups.
items.translation: 自动补全有效的记录器名称和记录器组。通常，当前项目中可用的包名和类名以及定义的组也可以进行自动补全。

items.source: Auto-completes the available bean names in the current project. Usually constrained by a base class that is specified by the target parameter.
items.translation: 自动完成当前项目中可用的 Bean 名称。通常受由 `target` 参数指定的基类约束。

items.source: The special any provider value permits any additional values to be provided. Regular value validation based on the property type should be applied if this is supported.
items.translation: 特殊的 `any` 提供者值允许提供任何其他附加值。如果支持此功能，则应基于属性类型应用常规值验证。

items.source: The class-reference provider auto-completes classes available in the project. This provider supports the following parameters:
items.translation: class-reference 提供器会自动补全项目中可用的类。此提供器支持以下参数：

items.source: The spring-bean-reference provider auto-completes the beans that are defined in the configuration of the current project. This provider supports the following parameters:
items.translation: spring-bean-reference 提供者自动完成当前项目配置中定义的 Bean。 此提供者支持以下参数：

items.source: The spring-profile-name provider auto-completes the Spring profiles that are defined in the configuration of the current project.
items.translation: spring-profile-name 提供程序会自动补全当前项目配置中定义的 Spring 配置文件。

items.source: The following metadata snippet corresponds to the standard spring.profiles.active property that defines the name of the Spring profile(s) to enable:
items.translation: 以下元数据片段对应于定义要启用的 Spring 配置文件名称的标准 spring.profiles.active 属性：

items.source: To improve the user experience and further assist the user in configuring a given property, you can provide additional metadata that:
items.translation: 为改善用户体验并进一步协助用户配置给定属性，您可以提供以下附加元数据：

items.source: Describes the list of potential values for a property.
items.translation: 描述属性的潜在值列表。

items.source: Associates a provider, to attach a well defined semantic to a property, so that a tool can discover the list of potential values based on the project’s context.
items.translation: 关联一个提供者，以便为属性附加明确的语义，从而使工具能够根据项目上下文发现潜在值列表。

items.source:
Providers are a powerful way to attach semantics to a property.
In this section, we define the official providers that you can use for your own hints.
However, your favorite IDE may implement some of these or none of them.
Also, it could eventually provide its own.
items.translation: 提供程序是一种为属性附加语义的强大方式。在本节中，我们定义您可以用于自身提示的官方提供程序。然而，您最喜爱的集成开发环境（IDE）可能会实现其中一些、部分或全部，也可能一个都不实现。此外，它最终也可能提供自己的提供程序。

items.source: The following table summarizes the list of supported providers:
items.translation: 下表总结了支持的提供者列表：

items.source: Permits any additional value to be provided.
items.translation: 允许提供额外的值。

items.source: Auto-completes the available Spring profile names in the project.
items.translation: 自动完成项目中可用的 Spring 配置文件名称。

items.source: This provider is typically used if you have a list of values and any extra values should still be considered as valid.
items.translation: 此提供者通常用于您拥有一组值且任何额外值仍应被视为有效的情况。

items.source: Note that, in the preceding example, any other value is also allowed.
items.translation: 注意，在上面的示例中，任何其他值也是允许的。

items.source:
The fully qualified name of the class that should be assignable to the chosen value.
  Typically used to filter out-non candidate classes.
  Note that this information can be provided by the type itself by exposing a class with the appropriate upper bound.
items.translation: 应赋值给选定值的类的完全限定名称。通常用于过滤掉非候选类。请注意，此信息可以通过类型本身暴露一个具有适当上界的类来提供。

items.source: Specify whether only concrete classes are to be considered as valid candidates.
items.translation: 指定是否仅将具体类视为有效候选项。

items.source:
The fully qualified name of the type to consider for the property.
  This parameter is mandatory.
items.translation: 要用于该属性的类型的完全限定名称。此参数为必需。

items.source: The following types can be used:
items.translation: 可以使用以下类型：

items.source: This provider supports the following parameters:
items.translation: 此提供者支持以下参数：

items.source: Specify whether known groups should be considered.
items.translation: 指定是否应考虑已知组。

items.source: Since a logger name can be any arbitrary name, this provider should allow any value but could highlight valid package and class names that are not available in the project’s classpath.
items.translation: 由于记录器名称可以是任意名称，此提供者应允许任何值，但可以突出显示项目中类路径中不可用的有效包和类名。

items.source:
The fully qualified name of the bean class that should be assignable to the candidate.
  Typically used to filter out non-candidate beans.
items.translation: 应可赋值给候选者的 Bean 类的完全限定名。通常用于过滤掉非候选者 Bean。

items.source: If multiple values can be provided, use a Collection or Array type to teach the IDE about it.
items.translation: 如果可以提供多个值，请使用 Collection 或 Array 类型来告知 IDE。

items.source: We recommend that you use an Enum for those two values instead. If your IDE supports it, this is by far the most effective approach to auto-completion.
items.translation: 我们建议使用 Enum 来替代这两个值。如果您的 IDE 支持此功能，这无疑是自动补全最有效的方法。

items.source: The binder is not aware of the metadata. If you provide that hint, you still need to transform the bean name into an actual Bean reference using by the ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 绑定器无法感知元数据。 如果您提供该提示，您仍然需要使用 ApplicationContext 将 Bean 名称转换为实际的 Bean 引用。

items.source: Hints can also be added for external types and are applied whenever that type is used.
items.translation: 提示也可以为外部类型添加，并在使用该类型时应用。

items.source: Only one provider can be active for a given property, but you can specify several providers if they can all manage the property in some way. Make sure to place the most powerful provider first, as the IDE must use the first one in the JSON section that it can handle. If no provider for a given property is supported, no special content assistance is provided, either.
items.translation: 对于给定的属性，只能有一个提供者处于活动状态，但如果您可以以某种方式管理该属性，则可以指定多个提供者。请确保将功能最强大的提供者放在最前面，因为 IDE 必须使用 JSON 部分中它能处理到的第一个提供者。如果某个属性没有支持的提供者，也不会提供任何特殊的内容辅助功能。

items.source: As this is a new feature, IDE vendors must catch up with how it works. Adoption times naturally vary.
items.translation: 由于这是一个新功能，IDE 供应商必须跟上其工作原理。 采用时间自然会有所不同。
